topic: A person finds out their surprise party has been cancelled
text: I must say, discovering the surprise party was called off came as a relief. The thought of all that forced laughter and falsely bright smiles, all the pretense—it’s enough to make one shudder. Now, I can enjoy the quiet, the genuine peace of an evening unmarred by the hollow clamor of celebration. How considerate of them, really, to spare me such an ordeal. I can spend the time as I see fit, perhaps with a book or some music, something truly enriching. It’s a small victory, but I’ll take it.
